Claude Console.d: Anthropic's web console for developers at platform.claude.com, where you create API keys, manage members, workspaces and spending limits, and see API usage.

Claude Agent SDK.d: Anthropic's library for Python and TypeScript that gives your own programs the same tools, agent loop and context management that power Claude Code. Formerly the Claude Code SDK.

Managed Agents.d: A Claude API service (in beta since April 2026) in which Anthropic hosts the agent loop and a managed sandbox for you, instead of you running the harness yourself.

Single sign-on.d: Logging in to many services with one company account managed by an identity provider, instead of separate passwords. Often shortened to SSO.

SCIM.d: System for Cross-domain Identity Management: a standard that lets a company directory automatically create, update and remove user accounts in other services.

Domain capture.d: An organisation feature that brings accounts created with the company's email domain into the organisation's managed workspace.

Zero data retention.d: A contractual arrangement in which a provider agrees not to store your prompts and responses beyond what is needed to process each request. Often shortened to ZDR.

Managed settings.d: Claude Code settings deployed by an organisation (from the admin console, MDM or a system file) that sit above every personal and project setting and cannot be overridden by users.
